name: NFTTrader
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier) to closeSwapIntent, or follow checks-effects-interactions pattern to update state before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step NFT swap/reentrancy case requiring understanding of the protocol-specific swap intent flow, ERC721 callbacks, and how counterparties are edited during receipt to steal victim-approved NFTs. The PoC is not deeply complex, but it involves several contract interactions, timing/block manipulation, and non-obvious logic rather than a simple single-call bug.
